summary: Lifetime Brands filed an 8-K reporting Q3 2026 results (Item 2.02) and, separately, that its board authorized boosting its existing share repurchase program to $20 million of availability as of the November 3, 2026 effective date, versus roughly $11.1 million prior. Repurchases may occur via open-market purchases (including Rule 10b5-1 plans), privately negotiated trades, accelerated share repurchases, block trades or tender offers; no expiration date, board may amend or terminate anytime. Shares outstanding were 22,984,460 as of October 31, 2026. Watch buyback execution pace against leverage and debt covenants.
